title: Supply, Installation and fixing of Galvanized anodes, carbon laminates, Epoxy grout etc for 2nd, Ist, and Ground Floor of Deep Bhavan office, Mumbai Office Building
summary: Short e-tender for structural repair of the Deep Bhavan office building in Mumbai (ground, first and second floors) using galvanized anodes, carbon laminates and epoxy grout.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai

sites.name: Deep Bhavan office, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai 400077
sites.work: Supply, installation and fixing of galvanized anodes, carbon laminates, epoxy grout for ground, 1st and 2nd floors

scope.item: Supply, Installation and fixing of Galvanized anodes, carbon laminates, Epoxy grout etc for 2nd, 1st and Ground Floor (no BOQ in this notice)

money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. EMD by account payee DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; tender fee Rs 500 non-refundable by DD. EMD and tender fee mandatory for all bidders; originals by 21.06.2024 16:00.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Reputed registered contractors/firms of appropriate category with tender limit equal to or more than the estimated cost, registered with Central Govt./State Govt./Municipal Corporation etc.
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 60%, or one >= 80%
Documentary evidence of annual turnover of last three years
Applicator certificate from manufacturer for application of carbon laminate/carbon fibre
specs: Galvanized anodes, carbon laminates/carbon fibre and epoxy grout (structural strengthening)
notes: Short tender notice (Hindi pages 1-3, English pages 4-6); no BOQ. Bid download/submission 14.06.2024 18:00 to 21.06.2024 17:00; pre-bid meeting and site visit 19.06.2024 11:00 at Deep Bhavan. Hindi version says bid validity from commercial bid opening, English from technical bid opening. Signed by Director (In-charge).
